lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills. A distinct cluster of four spots forms a trapezoidal arrangement in the central lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the primary spot centroids to form a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower margins, extending from the branchial region to the right frame edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small-diameter, high-luminance spots, significantly smaller in scale than the blobs observed on the lateral flank.
